name: Task Date Links
changes: Version 1.2.1 also changed the vault back-fill Pro notice for signed-in users.
If your sponsorship check has not ended or must run again, the notice only asks you to select Refresh.
If a check fails, the notice adds: If you already sponsor, select Refresh in the plugin settings.
tip: Add the property task-date-links: false to a note to keep date links out of it.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Task Date Links is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to keep your tasks in order.
